snippet.title: EoW: Willer's Dominion Cinematic Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A warrior who has forgotten himself. Whispers that cannot be silenced. And a curse you’re doomed to relive… again and again.

TPS rogue-lite game EoW: Willer’s Dominion is now on Steam! Every death is a beginning, and every beginning brings a little more madness. Upgrade your weapons, shape your build, and resist the Eye’s corruption as you descend into the darkest corners of your mind.

The first cinematic trailer is out now. Discover it on Steam and add it to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870800/EoW_Willers_Dominion

There is no escape from this cycle… but maybe, just maybe, there’s a way out.

#indiegame #roguelike #roguelike #steam #steamgame #ign
